method.human_jump: reference demo manoeuvres (evidence/manoeuvres_by_route.json), apex-split segments merged (ground flag is derived vz==0 and splits jumps at apex); void = floor drop below lower endpoint along the flight line, probe 512 u
method.corpus: per-run final void crossing in pipeline/out/paths/*.json tails: densified at 8 u, over-void where floor >120 u below origin (96 u void + 24 u hull), last contiguous stretch >=24 u before arrival
method.gap_geometry: floor grid probe at z=336: void strip y=-600..-664, ~350 u deep, spans x=-64..296; only connected floor around it is the eastern ramp corridor x~304-336 (floor z 196-288)
method.go_around: synthesized along that corridor (navmesh plan_many was rejected: its 'walk' path used a jump link straight over the void); waypoints on probed floor +24 u

quad_to_ra.envelope_gate_catches_go_around: no band exists (route absent from envelope_band.json) - gate cannot catch it

recommendation.verdict: The envelope gate CANNOT reliably catch the go-around on any RA-top route. The go-around corridor (z=264 walkway east to x~316, then the ramp up at x~300-330, then west along the RA ledge) is largely covered by the human corpus: the human line crosses that area earlier in the run (walkway crossing at x~280-360, z=264), and the envelope is an unordered point cloud with no notion of sequence or of being airborne. The synthesized go-around stays 43-63 u from each route's cloud: ring 60.3 vs band 84.3 (no), ralow 43.4 vs 47.8 (marginal - observed bot p95 was 50.8-52.5, a 3-5 u fail that any small line change erases), tunnel 62.8 vs 110.7 (no), quad_to_ra has no band at all. Confirmed empirically: in strict race_v7 env2, episodes from the two approach starts nearest RA-top passed the envelope on ring (27.3-35.0 u) and tunnel (37.3-80.8 u) while the owner reports the bot goes around.
recommendation.manoeuvre_requirement: Use pipeline/manoeuvres.py executed(): require, per RA-top route, an airborne segment whose takeoff is within 96 u of the human jump takeoff and whose next ground contact is within 96 u of the human landing, checked as one event (walking around and standing on the landing does not count). Additionally require void_u >= 96 for that segment via record_replay.air_segments() so a hop along the ledge cannot satisfy it. All machinery exists: executed() takes (pos, ground, Manoeuvre, tol); strict_eval already records pos+ground frames per episode in record_replay.record_route(). Anchor points per route: this file's human_jump takeoff/landing (reference), corpus takeoff/landing means as cross-check. 96 u tolerance covers the corpus takeoff spread (std x up to 38 u, tunnel).
